notes: The arXiv API returned HTTP 429 on both attempted queries, so the strict literature check was skipped and the Domain Reviewer's novelty profile, baseline scout and similarity run were done from knowledge with [verify] marks; the skill handles this fallback but does not say whether to retry later or how many retries to make. The skill lets the Domain Reviewer state what a prior paper does (e.g. OPRO) only from its abstract, which cannot be done offline, so I had to hedge that point as a question. The pool-position rule (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65) and the 'start every weight at 1.0' rule were easy to follow. The Phase 1.6 report-check table is somewhat artificial when one context writes the reports and checks them. The SKILL.md says the integrity scan redacted copy is what reviewers read, but a clean scan leaves the file unchanged (the script printed no redaction file path), which is ambiguous. ICLR venue label shows two scales (4 on the 2026 scale, 5 on the earlier one) and 'final_overall' maps to a venue label that is secondary-status.
